chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
“It is recommended that you count your weekly circumambulation in every day and night.”

key_terms.أُسْبُوعَكَ: your week; here referring to your set of tawaf circumambulations
key_terms.تُحْصِيَ: to count or keep careful track

ai.seo_question: Is it recommended to keep count of one’s tawaf during each day and night?
ai.summary: This hadith states the recommendation of keeping count of one’s tawaf cycles across the days and nights. It reflects an aspect of devotional order and attentiveness in acts of worship related to hajj.
